battle.name: 穆斯林征服馬格里布
battle.brief: 公元647年，哈比卜·本·阿比·烏拜達在迦太基近旁建「海濱拉巴特」，開啟馬格里布征服。其後六十餘年，哈里發軍攻取突尼斯、蘇塞、馬赫迪耶與的黎波里，708年取下丹吉爾，711年越海入西班牙。卡面埃及長矛屬早王朝青銅矛，早出本役四千餘年，僅作長矛一系祖型；陣上所見者為長槍、彎刀。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭的一方是拜占庭皇帝治下的阿非利加行省（Exarchate of Africa），即前汪達人統治過、602年因波斯戰爭而重新設置的總督區，首府在迦太基；另一方是661年穆阿維葉一世即位後重新編組起來的哈里發國家。哈里發國在開戰之初並無專設的西征軍，而是以埃及與敘利亞為基地、由各總督抽調的邊軍：647年落到易法基耶的前鋒是哈比卜·本·阿比·烏拜達·菲赫里，他修的「海濱拉巴特」是哈里發家在非洲的第一個永久據點；其後歷任易法基耶的統治者——歐卡巴·本·納菲、祖海爾·本·蓋斯、優素福·本·阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·菲赫里、哈桑·本·阿爾·努曼，直至穆薩·本·努賽爾——都以凱魯萬與突尼斯之間的軍營城為出師地，軍隊編制沿用希臘—羅馬的骨架：步兵核心是持長槍與圓盾的方陣兵，輔以輕裝散兵與弓手，騎兵是獨立的打擊主力，攻城時另配工匠、坑道隊與搬運隊。拜占庭一方則是一個正在耗盡的行省：總督區常備兵不多，主要靠莫羅—羅馬人社群的徵召兵、希臘雇兵，以及被迫應徵的柏柏爾部族兵；其地中海分艦隊是這段海岸唯一能快速反應的力量，705年之前卻幾乎沒有主動出擊。戰爭真正的對手是柏柏爾聯盟：宰那塔（Zenata）與馬斯穆達（Masmuḍa）諸部以游騎為本，逐城抵抗或退回山區。擊敗拜占庭本身並不難，難的是在沒有道路、沒有可守的城牆可依的內陸，把一個不斷重組的聯盟逐段拆開——這才是哈里發國在這場戰爭裡真正解決的問題。
countriesEn: On one side stood the Exarchate of Africa under the Byzantine emperor, that is to say the province that had been ruled by the Vandal kings and re-established in 602 after the Persian war, with its capital at Carthage. On the other stood the caliphal state, reorganized after Mu'awiya I took the throne in 661. At the outset there was no dedicated western expeditionary army: what existed was a frontier force mustered by the provincial governors out of Egypt and Syria. The vanguard that reached Ifriqiya in 647 was that of Habib ibn Abi Ubayda al-Fihri, and the Ribat of the Ocean he built was the first permanent foothold of the caliphate in Africa. The governors of Ifriqiya who followed him — Uqba ibn Nafi, Zuhayr ibn Qays, Yusuf ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Fihri, Hasan ibn al-Nu'man, and finally Musa ibn Nusayr — all used the garrison cities between Kairouan and Tunis as their starting points, and the armies kept the skeleton of the Greek and Roman system: a core of spear-and-round-shield infantry in formation, supported by light skirmishers and archers, with the cavalry as a separate striking arm, and detachments of engineers, miners and carriers assigned for sieges. The Byzantine side, meanwhile, was a province in the process of exhausting itself. The exarchate had few troops of its own and relied on levies from the Mauro-Roman communities, on Greek mercenaries, and on Berber contingents pressed into service. Its Mediterranean squadron was the only force on that coast able to react quickly, yet before 705 it had scarcely taken the initiative. The real opponent in the war was the Berber confederation: the Zenata and the Masmuḍa tribes, whose mode of war was the mounted raid, resisting town by town or withdrawing into the mountains. Defeating Byzantium itself was not difficult; what was difficult was breaking up, in an interior that had neither roads nor defensible walls, a confederation that kept re-forming. That is the problem the caliphal state actually solved in this war.
people: 留下姓名的多數來自阿拉伯方面的編年史，柏柏爾一方則幾乎沒有留下可核對的將領姓名，這種落差本身就是這場戰爭的一項史實。阿拉伯方面，647年主持興建海濱拉巴特的是哈比卜·本·阿比·烏拜達·菲赫里，他是菲赫里家族的開端，其孫優素福後來也做了易法基耶的統治者。歐卡巴·本·納菲是全役最關鍵的人物：他在665年自埃及出發攻入易法基耶，670年在斯法克斯與突尼斯之間的凱魯萬建下新城作為前進基地，681年把軍隊推到大西洋岸，行程遠達今摩洛哥的塔古爾特一帶，「極西之地」（al-Maghrib al-Aqṣā）之名即由此而來；683年他在今突尼斯境內斯貝特拉一帶的橡樹林被柏柏爾聯軍擊敗陣亡，首級據說被送至凱希娜面前，後世因此把她寫成陣前斬將的女王。祖海爾·本·蓋斯接手後與凱希娜訂約，兩方在693年被刺而後一度並肩作戰；優素福·本·阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·菲赫里在693至698年間以不承認哈里發的姿態統治易法基耶，哈桑·本·阿爾·努曼與穆薩·本·努賽爾在698年之後接掌局面：穆薩先以外交手段取得優素福的歸順與人質，再於698至699年間攻下迦太基，705年擊敗拜占庭的坎迪達圖斯艦隊，708年取下丹吉爾，並派塔里克·本·祖亞德於711年渡海入西班牙；他自己在711至713年間被召回大馬士革，死於途中。柏柏爾方面，凱希娜與丹吉爾的守將尤利烏斯是僅存的兩個名字：前者被阿拉伯史家描寫為與拜占庭結盟以驅逐阿拉伯人，後者被寫為接受拜占庭許諾的「朱利烏斯」；當代史家多認為這兩段記述摻雜了神話成分，但柏柏爾有組織的抵抗本身並非虛構。哈里發那一端的最高決策者是阿卜杜勒·馬利克·本·馬爾萬（685至705年在位）與瓦利德一世（705至715年），真正在前方定計劃的是哈桑與穆薩；而留下最早文字記錄的，是九世紀的史家艾布·賈法爾·穆罕默德·本·賈里爾·阿爾·巴拉祖里。
peopleEn: Most of the names that survive come from the Arabic chronicles; the Berber side has left almost no commander whose name can be checked, and that gap is itself a fact about this war. On the Arab side, the man who directed the building of the Ribat of the Ocean in 647 was Habib ibn Abi Ubayda al-Fihri, the founder of the Fihri line, whose grandson Yusuf was later to rule Ifriqiya. The most consequential figure of the whole campaign was Uqba ibn Nafi. He struck into Ifriqiya from Egypt in 665, founded the new city of Kairouan between Sfax and Tunis in 670 as a forward base, and in 681 drove his army to the Atlantic, as far as Tagoult in modern Morocco, from which the name of the far west, al-Maghrib al-Aqsa, derives. In 683 he was defeated and killed by a Berber confederate force in the oaks near Sbeitla in modern Tunisia, and his head is said to have been carried to Kahina, which is why later generations cast her as the queen who slew the enemy general on the field. Zuhayr ibn Qays took over and made terms with Kahina, and the two of them fought side by side until he was murdered in 693. Yusuf ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Fihri ruled Ifriqiya from 693 to 698 in a posture that refused to acknowledge the caliph. Hasan ibn al-Nu'man and Musa ibn Nusayr took charge after 698: Musa first won over Yusuf by diplomatic means, taking hostages, and then took Carthage between 698 and 699; in 705 he defeated the Byzantine squadron of Candidatus; in 708 he took Tangier; and he sent Tariq ibn Ziyad across the strait in 711. He himself was recalled to Damascus in 711 to 713 and died on the road. On the Berber side, Kahina and Julian, the defender of Tangier, are the only two names: she is described by the Arabic historians as having allied with Byzantium to drive the Arabs out, and he as the Iulian who accepted Byzantine promises. Modern historians generally hold that both stories are heavily mixed with legend, though the organised Berber resistance itself is not an invention. On the caliphal side the highest decisions belonged to Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan, who reigned from 685 to 705, and to al-Walid I, who reigned from 705 to 715, while the plans in the field were made by Hasan and Musa. The earliest written record comes from the ninth-century historian Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Jarir al-Baladhuri.
kits: 卡面上的埃及長矛屬於早王朝時期，約前3200年，銅或青銅矛頭以榫接方式裝在木杆上，年代比這場戰爭早了將近四千年，不可能出現在647年之後的北非；它之所以配在這張卡上，是因為它是「柄端加重的直刺長矛」這條技術路線的祖型——在埃及，早王朝之後的銅矛、戈與斧並肩發展，矛尖愈做愈窄，愈適合作為刺穿而非劈砍的武器，這條路線後來在黎凡特與安納托利亞定型，進入希臘—羅馬世界，成為步兵方陣的標準裝備。真正出現在本役的阿拉伯軍裝備如下：步兵以短柄微彎的阿拉伯劍（saif）與長匕首為主；槍械分兩種，騎兵用長逾三米、矛頭窄小的長槍（阿拉伯語 rimḥ，與希臘式長槍同類），步兵用可擲投的標槍；弓為複合反曲弓，長約七十至八十厘米，配鐵鏃箭；防具是木胎蒙革的圓盾，外覆皮革，直徑多在六十至七十厘米之間，早期伊斯蘭軍的傘形長盾要到八世紀之後才普遍；甲胄方面，部隊初期多穿皮甲或層疊的布甲，貴族與突擊手穿鎖子甲（khazāʾin），頭盔為薩珊式球頂尖盔（ṭāj），帶護頸。拜占庭與受其節制的柏柏爾一方則是另一套配備：拜占庭步兵沿用晚期羅馬的長柄直劍（spathion）、雙刃短劍與大橢圓盾（skouton），重裝兵有札甲騎士（kataphraktoi）與鎧甲弓手，希臘風格的弓箭是遠程主力；柏柏爾游騎用標槍、小圓盾、匕首與短劍，弓亦為複合弓。攻城方面，見於記載或可推知的是撞槌（makhfīq）、雲梯、坑道與臨時塔架，另有以海軍封鎖港灣、斷絕城中糧食的做法。運輸與補給靠駱駝隊，這在北非內陸的乾旱地帶比羅馬式車隊與拜占庭式糧道更有優勢，馬匹多來自阿拉伯半島的牧場與比希拉的良種馬。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card belongs to the Early Dynastic period, around 3200 BC, with a copper or bronze head socketed onto a wooden shaft, and it predates this war by nearly four thousand years, so it could not have been in North Africa after 647. It is put on this card because it is the ancestor of the technical line of the weighted thrusting spear: in Egypt after the Early Dynastic period the copper spear, the dagger-axe and the axe developed side by side, the head becoming ever narrower and ever better suited to thrusting rather than to chopping, and that line was later fixed in the Levant and in Anatolia, entered the Greek and Roman world, and became the standard equipment of the infantry phalanx. The arms the Arab army actually carried in this campaign were as follows. Infantry had the short, slightly curved Arab sword, the saif, and a long dagger. There were two kinds of spear: the cavalry used a lance more than three metres long with a narrow head, the rimh, comparable to the Greek sarissa, while the infantry used javelins fitted to be thrown. The bow was a composite recurved bow about seventy to eighty centimetres long, with iron-tipped arrows. Protection was a round shield of wood covered in hide, sixty to seventy centimetres across, and the tall umbrella-shaped shield of the early Islamic armies does not become general until after the eighth century. On armour, the troops in the first years wore leather or layered cloth, while the notables and the shock troops wore mail, the khazain, and the helmet was the Sasanian globose pointed type, the taj, with a neck guard. The Byzantines and the Berbers under their authority wore a different set: Byzantine infantry followed the late Roman long straight sword, the spathion, with the double-edged short sword and the large oval shield, the skouton, their heavy troops included the armoured lancers, the kataphraktoi, and the mail-clad archers, with the Greek-style bow the main arm at range; the Berber riders carried javelins, small round shields, daggers and short swords, and their bow was likewise a composite. On siege work, what the sources record or allow one to infer are the battering ram, the makhfiq, ladders, mines and improvised towers, together with the practice of using the fleet to seal the harbours and cut the grain from the city. Transport and supply rested on camel trains, which in the dry interior of North Africa had an advantage over the Roman cart system and the Byzantine grain road, and the horses came mostly from the pastures of the Arabian peninsula and from the fine stock of Khaybar.
tactics: 全役可以拆成四個階段，戰術形態一換再換。第一階段是647至670年的試探性遠征：遠征隊沿地中海東岸行軍，靠海運補給，奪取海濱拉巴特與突尼斯附近的據點，艦隊沿海岸線同步推進，使柏柏爾人無法在內陸游擊到斷糧——這是阿拉伯軍第一次把海軍護衛陸上走廊的想法用起來。第二階段是歐卡巴的縱深進攻（670至683年）：他在凱魯萬設防作為前進基地，兵分兩路推進至斯法克斯與大西洋岸，補給線愈拉愈長；683年的橡樹林之戰正是這條過長的補給線與分散搜索的騎兵隊所招致，柏柏爾聯軍利用地形與熟悉的水井，以游騎不斷消耗、襲擾、分割，最後合圍。教訓直接改變了此後的作戰方式：阿拉伯軍不再追求深入內陸的速決，而改為以重裝步兵為骨、以柏柏爾騎兵為翼，穆薩與哈桑大量招募當地柏柏爾青年為輔助兵，讓他們隨軍作戰、分享戰利品，同時以縱隊穩紮穩打、逐城施壓。第三階段是698至708年的攻堅與分化：對迦太基、突尼斯、蘇塞、馬赫迪耶等城，哈里發軍先以海軍封鎖港口、切斷城中運糧，再集中步騎於陸路一處突破口；同時以條約與分封手段爭取柏柏爾首領，優素福的歸順正是這樣得來的。第四階段是711年的渡海作戰：塔里克以柏柏爾人為主力的軍隊在直布羅陀海峽北岸登陸，關於登陸點另有說法指在加那利群島一帶，加那利島之名即源於此說，主流記載則指海峽北岸的塔里克山；其後沿海岸北上，於711年7月26日在瓜達萊特河畔擊敗西哥特王羅德里克，軍隊隨即進入安達盧斯。整體戰術核心只有三條：以海軍維持補給與封鎖、以柏柏爾騎兵作機動作戰與衝鋒、以攻城與條約交替使用來對付一個沒有固定國界的對手。
tacticsEn: The whole campaign divides into four phases, and the form of fighting changes at every step. The first, from 647 to 670, is the exploratory expedition: the column moved along the eastern shore of the Mediterranean, drew its supply from the sea, seized the Ribat of the Ocean and the posts around Tunis, and the fleet advanced along the coast in step with it, so that the Berbers could not raid in the interior and cut the line of supply. This was the first time the Arab army used the idea of a fleet escorting a corridor on land. The second phase is Uqba's advance in depth, from 670 to 683: he established Kairouan as a forward base, pushed in two columns toward Sfax and toward the Atlantic, and his supply line grew longer and longer. The defeat in the oaks in 683 was the consequence of that over-extended line and of mounted detachments spread out to forage, for the Berber confederation used the terrain and its own knowledge of the wells to wear them down, to harry them, to split them, and finally to close around them. The lesson changed the way the war was fought at once. The Arab army no longer sought a quick decision in the interior, and took instead a heavy infantry core with Berber cavalry on the wings; Musa and Hasan recruited large numbers of local Berber youths as auxiliaries, let them fight under the army and share the booty, and advanced in column with the security of a settled pace, pressing town by town. The third phase, from 698 to 708, is siege and division: against Carthage, Tunis, Sousse and Mahdia the caliphal fleet first sealed the harbours and cut the grain from the city, and the infantry and cavalry were then concentrated on a single point of the land approaches; alongside this, treaties and the granting of authority were used to win over the Berber chiefs, and it was in this way that Yusuf's submission was obtained. The fourth phase, in 711, is the crossing. The army that Tariq led, Berbers in the majority, landed on the northern shore of the strait of Gibraltar; there is another account that places the landing in the vicinity of the Canaries, from which the name of the islands is usually derived, while the mainstream record points to Jabal Tariq on the northern bank. The army then moved north along the coast and defeated the Visigothic king Roderic by the Guadalete on 26 July 711, and entered al-Andalus. Three ideas run through all of it: the fleet to hold open the supply and to seal the ports, Berber horse for manoeuvre and for the charge, and siege and treaty used in turn against an opponent who had no fixed frontier.
data: 可核對的數字分三類，來源可靠程度相差很大。第一類是阿拉伯編年史明確記載的年表：647年海濱拉巴特落成；665年歐卡巴自埃及出發進入易法基耶；670年凱魯萬建城；681年軍隊抵達大西洋岸；683年橡樹林之戰與歐卡巴陣亡；693年祖海爾被刺；698年優素福歸順、迦太基易手；705年穆薩擊敗拜占庭艦隊；708年丹吉爾陷落；711年塔里克渡海，七月二十六日瓜達萊特之戰。次一類是編年史描寫的兵馬：阿爾·巴拉祖里記載穆薩征丹吉爾時統率一萬上下，遠征軍總數在不同抄本中從數千到數萬不等；拜占庭方面自642年起每年向易法基耶方向派出遠征分隊，規模約在數千至一萬之間；705年的海戰雙方艦船數均為數百艘之譜，阿爾·巴拉祖里所記的三百艘一類的數字在異文中頗有出入；丹吉爾守軍與其柏柏爾盟友的數量，阿拉伯文獻裡從數萬到不足一萬都有，無一可信。第三類是地理數字，最為可靠：凱魯萬距突尼斯約六十公里，自埃及開羅到突尼斯的陸路約一千五百公里，經海濱拉巴特的最短海路約一千二百公里；丹吉爾海峽最窄處約十四公里；馬格里布海岸線自迦太基延伸到大西洋岸逾一千五百公里；拜占庭的阿非利加行省包含阿非利加普羅孔撒拉利斯、比扎克納、努米底亞與的黎波里塔尼亞四個區，征服後支撐軍糧的正是斯法克斯周邊的產糧平原。此外考古與錢幣可以補充人口與財政的量級：北非伊斯蘭初期窖藏中最早的銅錢與玻璃秤砣，說明征服初期已建立實地的稅收徵集；開羅清真寺的早期銘文與伊斯蘭墓誌中，也讀得出征服者的名號與年歲。傷亡數字一概不可考：阿拉伯史料只說慘敗與損失慘重而不給數目，柏柏爾方面的損失連記載都沒有留下。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall into three classes of very unequal reliability. The first is the chronology the Arabic chronicles set down explicitly: the Ribat of the Ocean founded in 647; Uqba's departure from Egypt into Ifriqiya in 665; the founding of Kairouan in 670; the army's arrival at the Atlantic in 681; the battle in the oaks and the death of Uqba in 683; the murder of Zuhayr in 693; the submission of Yusuf and the fall of Carthage in 698; Musa's defeat of the Byzantine squadron in 705; the fall of Tangier in 708; and Tariq's crossing in 711, with the battle of Guadalete on 26 July. The second class is the strength of the forces as the narratives describe them. Al-Baladhuri has Musa advancing on Tangier with about ten thousand men, while the size of the expeditionary force varies in the different copies from several thousand to tens of thousands; on the Byzantine side, detachments were sent towards Ifriqiya every year from 642, on a scale running from several thousand to some ten thousand; in the naval engagement of 705 both fleets are put at some hundreds of ships, the figure of three hundred and the like that al-Baladhuri gives being subject to considerable variation in the transmitted text; and the numbers of the garrison of Tangier and of its Berber allies run in the Arabic literature from tens of thousands to fewer than ten thousand, none of them credible. The third class is geographical, and it is the most reliable. Kairouan lies about sixty kilometres from Tunis; the land road from Cairo to Tunis is about fifteen hundred kilometres, and the shortest sea route through the Ribat of the Ocean about twelve hundred; the narrowest point of the strait at Tangier is about fourteen kilometres; the Maghrib coast runs for more than fifteen hundred kilometres from Carthage to the Atlantic; and the Byzantine exarchate of Africa comprised the four regions of Africa Proconsularis, Byzacena, Numidia and Tripolitania, with the grain plains around Sfax supplying the armies after the conquest. Archaeology and coinage add something to the scale of population and of finance: the earliest coins and glass weights in the hoards of early Islamic North Africa show that a working system of tax collection existed from the first years of the conquest, and the early inscriptions of the mosque at Cairo and the Islamic epitaphs yield the names and dates of the conquerors. Casualty figures cannot be checked at all. The Arabic sources say only that the defeat was severe and the losses heavy, without giving a number, and the losses on the Berber side were not recorded anywhere.
cause: 原因有四層。最表層是哈里發國的擴張衝動：穆罕默德死後的第一次內戰讓阿拉伯人退回半島，661年穆阿維葉一世重整秩序之後，國家機器把重心由半島轉向拜占庭邊境，而易法基耶正卡在埃及的西翼——拜占庭的總督區一旦修復，就會成為反攻埃及的跳板；攻下它則等於在哈里發國的西側立起一道壁壘。第二層是拜占庭自身的處境：阿非利加行省在五個世紀的汪達統治與六世紀初的波斯戰爭之後元氣盡失，稅收銳減而軍隊縮水，帝國在這裡只能靠外省兵與雇兵撐住局面；拜占庭也曾企圖在六百四十年代到七十年代向易法基耶方向反攻，並把北非的柏柏爾首領爭取到自己一方，據六世紀末的西哥特編年史記載，拜占庭與西哥特還曾聯手自西班牙出兵支援北非，結果在內陸被柏柏爾聯軍擊潰，那是拜占庭在北非最後一次大規模的反攻。同時拜占庭的稅制與徵兵在柏柏爾地區激起普遍不滿，許多部族寧可改宗，也不願再被拉去替帝國作戰。第三層是柏柏爾人自己的政治：各部族並沒有統一國家，凱希娜那樣的統治者靠聯盟與聯姻維持權力，一旦出現共同的外敵，聯盟可以迅速集結；但聯盟內部的裂痕同樣意味著可以用分化和收編的方式把它拆散。第四層最深，是地中海的整體格局：拜占庭在義大利與西班牙已失北非，只剩迦太基與安達盧斯之間的一條聯繫線，北非的糧食、橄欖油與橫穿撒哈拉的黃金通道若留在拜占庭或柏柏爾人手中，馬格里布便永遠是哈里發世界西緣的一個缺口。於是先取北非、再取西班牙，成為一條清楚的路線，而西哥特王國曾經援助北非，也讓北非的優先級壓過了東方的其他戰場。
causeEn: There are four layers of cause. The shallowest is the expansionary drive of the caliphal state. After the first civil war following the death of Muhammad, the Arabs were drawn back onto the peninsula; when Mu'awiya I restored order in 661, the machinery of the state shifted its weight from the peninsula to the Byzantine frontier, and Ifriqiya sat squarely on the western flank of Egypt. A restored exarchate would have been a springboard for a Byzantine counteroffensive against Egypt, and taking it would set a wall on the western side of the caliphate. The second layer is the condition of Byzantium itself. After five centuries of Vandal rule and the Persian war at the start of the sixth century, the province of Africa had lost its strength, its revenue had shrunk and its army had thinned, and the empire could hold the place together there only with troops from other provinces and with mercenaries. Byzantium attempted counteroffensives towards Ifriqiya in the 640s and 670s and tried to win the Berber chiefs of North Africa to its own side; and, according to the Visigothic chronicle written at the end of the seventh century, Byzantium and the Visigoths even sent a combined force from Spain to support North Africa, which was destroyed by the Berber confederation inland, the last large Byzantine counteroffensive in the region. At the same time the Byzantine tax system and its recruiting produced widespread resentment among the Berbers, and many tribes found it preferable to convert rather than be taken to fight for the empire a second time. The third layer is the Berbers' own politics. There was no unified state among the tribes; rulers like Kahina held power through alliance and marriage, and a common enemy could rally a confederation quickly. But the fractures inside that confederation meant just as surely that it could be taken apart by division and by recruitment. The deepest layer is the shape of the Mediterranean as a whole. Byzantium had lost North Africa in Italy and in Spain and kept only the thread between Carthage and al-Andalus; if the grain, the olive oil and the trans-Saharan gold road of North Africa stayed in Byzantine or Berber hands, the Maghrib would remain a permanent gap in the western edge of the caliphal world. Taking North Africa first and Spain second therefore became a clear line of strategy, and the fact that the Visigothic kingdom had aided North Africa put the Maghrib ahead of the other fronts.
impact: 影響分三條線。第一條是政治地理線：拜占庭在阿非利加的統治終結，迦太基遭到第三次毀滅，五百三十四年是汪達人的毀滅，六百九十八年是阿拉伯人的毀滅，前基督教羅馬世界在西部最後一個行政單位消失；與此同時，易法基耶的凱魯萬、突尼斯、馬赫迪耶先後成為伊斯蘭世界的首都與港口，馬格里布從羅馬的行省變成哈里發國的前線與稅源；新城沿海岸線排開，次序幾乎就是海軍航線的次序，這是海軍決定城市地理的一個典型樣本。第二條是族群與文化線：這場戰爭是阿拉伯化與伊斯蘭化分離的起點，馬格里布的居民以柏柏爾人與羅馬化基督徒為主，征服後大批柏柏爾部族改宗並被編入軍隊，幾代之間阿拉伯語在沿海城市成為通用語，但柏柏爾語與柏柏爾政治傳統並未消失，反而在伊斯蘭框架內延續：八世紀末建都非斯的伊德里斯王朝、設於塔赫特的魯斯塔米派伊巴德國家、馬格里布的巴爾加瓦塔教派、九至十世紀的阿格里夫王朝，以及其後的阿爾穆拉維德與阿爾莫哈德，多數出自柏柏爾人之手。第三條是跨海線：711年之後，穆斯林在安達盧斯建立政權，把基督教的安達盧西亞貴族、修士與農民引向北方，法蘭克王國與教宗捲入對抗；安達盧斯與北非之間的人員與貨物流動，使西地中海進入另一個時代，拜占庭在義大利的殘餘也面臨新的壓力。與此同時阿拉伯世界的分裂隨之而來：750年阿拔斯革命之後，馬格里布與安達盧斯先後脫離巴格達的中央，而十世紀初把首都遷往開羅的法蒂瑪王朝，正是從馬格里布這片土地起家。總的來說，馬格里布的征服既終結了一個舊世界，也把新的分裂帶到了西邊。
impactEn: The consequences run on three lines. The first is political and geographical. The Byzantine government of Africa came to an end, Carthage was destroyed for a third time, once by the Vandals in 534 and once by the Arabs in 698, and the last administrative unit of the pre-Christian Roman world in the west disappeared. At the same time Kairouan, Tunis and Mahdia in Ifriqiya in turn became capitals and harbours of the Islamic world, and the Maghrib changed from a Roman province into the frontier and the revenue base of the caliphate. The new cities stand in a line along the coast, and their order is very nearly the order of the naval route, a typical case of the fleet determining the geography of cities. The second line is ethnic and cultural. This war is the point at which Arabisation and Islamisation come apart: the population of the Maghrib was mostly Berbers and Romanised Christians, and after the conquest large numbers of Berber tribes converted and were enrolled in the armies, so that within a few generations Arabic became the common speech of the coastal towns; but Berber language and Berber political tradition did not disappear, and instead carried on inside the Islamic frame. The Idrisid dynasty, which founded its capital at Fez at the end of the eighth century, the Ibadi Rustamid state at Tahert, the Barghawata sect in Morocco, the Aghlabid dynasty of the ninth and tenth centuries, and later the Almoravids and the Almohads, were mostly the work of Berbers. The third line is the line across the water. After 711 the Muslim authorities in al-Andalus drew the Christian nobility, clergy and peasantry of Andalusi northwards, and the Frankish kingdom and the papacy were drawn into the quarrel; the movement of people and goods between al-Andalus and North Africa carried the western Mediterranean into another age, and the Byzantine remnant in Italy came under fresh pressure. At the same time the caliphal world began to break up. After the Abbasid revolution of 750, the Maghrib and al-Andalus fell away from the centre in Baghdad one after another, and the Fatimid dynasty, which moved its capital to Cairo at the beginning of the tenth century, was itself a creation of this Maghrib. In sum, the conquest of the Maghrib ended an old world and at the same time carried a new division into the west.
result: 結果分三層。就軍事而言，到708年丹吉爾陷落、709至710年間北非與極西之地各部首領陸續歸順為止，哈里發國在六十餘年裡完成了對易法基耶、的黎波里塔尼亞與馬格里布的軍事接管；711年塔里克渡海入安達盧斯，712年穆薩在阿爾赫塞拉斯被處決，戰線自此越過海峽。就制度而言，哈里發國留下三樣東西：一是把柏柏爾人編入軍隊、讓其充當騎兵主力的做法，此後安達盧斯的軍隊同樣以柏柏爾人與柏柏爾化的西班牙人為骨幹；二是海軍封鎖配合分段攻堅、再以條約分化的戰役樣板；三是把征服地改造成稅源的財政制度，以土地稅與丁稅為主，阿格里夫與法蒂瑪王朝接手時的財政基礎已在此時奠定。就長遠而言，馬格里布並未因為被征服而安靜：柏柏爾人退回阿特拉斯山與里夫山區，組織游擊與自己的王朝，直到十六世紀被鄂圖曼帝國平定為止，始終是伊斯蘭世界西緣的變數；而被征服地的基督社群在九至十世紀大量渡海北上，進入比利牛斯山另一側，安達盧斯基督教王國於此後三個世紀陸續興起，構成了西方基督教世界與哈里發世界在伊比利亞半島的長期對峙，732年圖爾戰役就是這條路線上的一個節點。整體而言，穆斯林征服馬格里布以軍事勝利開場，以制度移植與族群整合收尾，留下一個既伊斯蘭化又保有柏柏爾性格、並在此後八個世紀裡不斷向北方施加壓力的西緣。
resultEn: The result can be read on three levels. Militarily, by the fall of Tangier in 708 and the successive submissions of the chiefs of North Africa and of the far west through 709 and 710, the caliphal state had completed its military takeover of Ifriqiya, Tripolitania and the Maghrib; in 711 Tariq crossed into al-Andalus, and in 712 Musa was executed at Algeciras, the front moving beyond the strait. Institutionally, the caliphal state left three things behind. First, the practice of enlisting the Berbers into the army and using them as the main body of the horse, a practice of which the armies of al-Andalus afterwards made the same use, with Berbers and Berberised Spaniards as their backbone. Second, a template of siege and manoeuvre, in which the fleet sealed the ports, the resistance was broken segment by segment, and treaties did the rest of the work. Third, a fiscal system that turned conquered land into revenue, resting on the land tax and the poll tax, which is the financial foundation the Aghlabids and the Fatimids inherited when they took over. In the longer run the Maghrib did not grow quiet because it had been conquered. The Berbers withdrew into the Atlas and the Rif, organised their raids and founded their own dynasties, and remained a variable on the western edge of the Islamic world until the Ottomans settled the question in the sixteenth century. And the Christian communities of the conquered lands crossed north in large numbers during the ninth and tenth centuries to the far side of the Pyrenees, while the Christian kingdoms of al-Andalus rose in the three centuries that followed, setting up the long confrontation between the Christian West and the caliphal world in the Iberian peninsula, of which the battle of Tours in 732 is one of the nodes. Taken as a whole, the Muslim conquest of the Maghrib opened with a military victory, closed with the transplantation of institutions and the integration of peoples, and left behind a western frontier that was Islamised yet kept its Berber character, and that pressed northward for the eight centuries that followed.
